item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:45 AM 29 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Batuan, Dimasalang, Palanas, Cataingan, PioV.Corpuz, Uson, SanFernando, SanPascual, Cawayan, Placer, Esperanza), #NorthernSamar(Capul, SanAntonio, SanVicente), #Sorsogon(Matnog, Bulan, SantaMagdalena, Irosin, Bulusan), #Albay(Oas, CityOfLigao, Libon, PioDuran, Guinobatan, Jovellar, Camalig, Polangui, Daraga, LegazpiCity, SantoDomingo, Bacacay, Malilipot, CityOfTabaco, Malinao, Tiwi), #CamarinesSur(Bato, Balatan, Nabua, Bula, Baao, IrigaCity, Buhi), #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Capalonga, JosePanganiban, Paracale, Vinzons), #OrientalMindoro(CityOfCalapan, Naujan, Baco, SanTeodoro) and #Marinduque(Mogpog) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(Catarman, LopeDeVega, Mondragon, Bobon, SanJose, Allen, Lavezares, Rosario, Biri, Victoria and SanIsidro) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
